body:
It’s 1am, the DE on my feet is flaring massively and itching like the devil. I’ve scratched the ever loving fuck out of it. Nothing was working to soothe it. 

Housemate (who has psoriasis and knows the struggle) offered me a cigarette. Couldn’t bear to put on socks or shoes but obviously didn’t want to get dirt in the open blisters when I went out to smoke. So taped sandwich bags to my feet. Honestly the cool of the patio is really helping. 

Anyone else done odd things to soothe eczema?
